# Getman

> Getman is an open source API client (a Postman alternative): desktop app (Tauri + React), self-hosted server for teams (accounts, 2FA, roles, live sync), Git-based workspaces, Postman-compatible scripts, encrypted backups, and an AI assistant that uses the user's own LLM key and answers from this documentation.

Every page has YAML frontmatter with `status`:
- `implemented`: works in the current version.
- `partial`: some parts work; the page says which.
- `planned`: designed but NOT available yet. Never tell users a planned feature exists.

When answering users, prefer `docs/limitations.md` for "can Getman do X?" questions.

## Product
- [Product spec and roadmap](SPEC.md): vision, feature list, phases, what is in/out of scope.
- [Known limitations](limitations.md): everything that does not work yet, with workarounds.

## Guides
- [Getting started](guides/getting-started.md): install, run, first request, chaining requests.
- [Self-hosting the server](guides/self-hosting.md): Docker, configuration, HTTPS, backups, connecting the app.

## Features
- [Variables and environments](features/variables.md): scopes, precedence, shared vs local values, secrets.
- [Scripts (pm API)](features/scripts.md): pre-request and test scripts, full pm.* reference, sandbox.
- [Import and export](features/import-export.md): Postman, OpenAPI, cURL, Getman YAML; field mapping.
- [Git workspaces](features/git.md): store a workspace as YAML in a Git repo, commit/push/pull from Getman, conflicts.
- [Accounts, invitations and password reset](features/accounts.md): sign up, verify email, invite people without an account, forgot password, servers without SMTP.
- [Roles and permissions](features/roles.md): owner/admin/editor/viewer matrix.
- [Backup and restore](features/backup.md): encrypted, scheduled backups to S3 / server folder / PostgreSQL; restore.
- [AI assistant](features/ai-assistant.md): chat that answers from these docs with your own key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama…) or a workspace key.

## Architecture
- [Overview](architecture/overview.md): monorepo layout, packages, request lifecycle.
- [Data model](architecture/data-model.md): Workspace, Collection, Request, Variable types.
- [Storage modes](architecture/storage.md): Local, self-hosted Server (sync, conflicts, offline), Git.
- [Server API](architecture/server-api.md): REST endpoints, error codes, sync protocol, WebSocket events.
- [Security](architecture/security.md): accounts, passwords, 2FA, sessions, secrets, script isolation.
- [Design system](architecture/design-system.md): colour tokens and UI conventions.
